title: TATG: Tracking-Aware Testing Objective for LLM-based Test Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.03194v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Complex Java methods challenge automated unit test generation, as achieving high coverage and fault detection requires satisfying intricate testing requirements involving program states, execution paths, and assertions. Existing LLM-based approaches leverage program context, static analysis, and dynamic feedback but lack explicit tracking of individual testing requirements across iterations, potentially leading to redundant generation and unresolved testing objectives.   We present TATG, a tracking-aware LLM-based unit test generation framework that unifies structural coverage and mutation-based fault detection. TATG introduces a structured objective representation capturing testing requirements derived from static analysis and dynamic feedback, enabling fine-grained tracking of their satisfaction status. It employs a two-stage workflow that first improves structural coverage and subsequently strengthens assertions through mutation-g

translated_title: TATG：面向基于大语言模型测试生成的追踪感知测试目标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.03194v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：复杂的 Java 方法对自动化单元测试生成提出了挑战，因为要实现高覆盖率和故障检测能力，需要满足涉及程序状态、执行路径和断言的复杂测试需求。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法虽然利用了程序上下文、静态分析和动态反馈，但缺乏对单个测试需求在迭代过程中的显式追踪，可能导致冗余生成和未能解决的测试目标。我们提出了 TATG，这是一个追踪感知的、基于 LLM 的单元测试生成框架，它将结构覆盖与基于变异的故障检测统一起来。TATG 引入了一种结构化的目标表示，用于捕获由静态分析和动态反馈导出的测试需求，从而能够对其满足状态进行细粒度追踪。该框架采用两阶段工作流：首先提升结构覆盖率，随后通过变异测试强化断言……
tldr: 提出了TATG框架，通过结构化目标表示对测试需求的满足状态进行细粒度追踪，并采用两阶段工作流（先提升结构覆盖率、再通过变异测试强化断言），改进了基于大语言模型的Java单元测试生成。
en_tdlr: TATG is a tracking-aware LLM-based unit test generation framework that uses structured objective representations to fine-grainedly track the satisfaction status of testing requirements, employing a two-stage workflow that first improves structural coverage and then strengthens assertions through mutation testing.
